Fair_Havens@Act.27.8.description: Fair Havens, a harbor on the island of Crete where Paul's ship stopped during his journey to Rome.
Fair_Havens@Act.27.8.name: Fair_Havens

Felix@Act.23.24-.description: Felix was a Roman governor of Judea who heard the case against Paul and kept him in custody for two years.
Felix@Act.23.24-.name: Felix

Festus@Act.24.27-.description: Porcius Festus succeeded Felix as the Roman governor of Judea and heard Paul's case, ultimately sending him to Rome for trial.
Festus@Act.24.27-.name: Festus

Fish_Gate@2Ch.33.14-Zep.description: The Fish Gate, a gate in Jerusalem's wall, was rebuilt by the sons of Hassenaah during Nehemiah's time and was a location of judgment and trade.
Fish_Gate@2Ch.33.14-Zep.name: Fish_Gate

Forest_Ephraim@2Sa.18.6.description: The Forest of Ephraim, where the battle between David's forces and Absalom's army took place during Absalom's rebellion.
Forest_Ephraim@2Sa.18.6.name: Forest_Ephraim

Fortunatus@1Co.16.17-.description: Fortunatus was a Corinthian Christian who, along with Stephanas and Achaicus, visited Paul in Ephesus and refreshed his spirit.
Fortunatus@1Co.16.17-.name: Fortunatus

Fortune@Isa.65.11.description: Fortune, mentioned in <ref="Isaiah 65:11">Isaiah 65:11</ref>, is a pagan deity associated with luck and prosperity, which some Israelites worshipped, forsaking the Lord.
Fortune@Isa.65.11.name: Fortune

Forum_of_Appius@Act.28.15.description: The Forum of Appius, a marketplace on the Appian Way, where Christians from Rome met Paul during his journey to the city as a prisoner.
Forum_of_Appius@Act.28.15.name: Forum_of_Appius

Foundation_Gate@2Ch.23.5.description: The Foundation Gate, a gate in Jerusalem's wall, where a third of the Levite singers were positioned during the coronation of Joash.
Foundation_Gate@2Ch.23.5.name: Foundation_Gate

Fountain_Gate@Neh.2.14-.description: The Fountain Gate, a gate in Jerusalem's wall, was rebuilt by Shallun during Nehemiah's time and was a location for processions and gatherings.
Fountain_Gate@Neh.2.14-.name: Fountain_Gate

Freedmen@Act.6.9.description: The Freedmen, mentioned in <ref="Act.6.9">Act.6.9</ref>, were likely former Jewish slaves who had been granted freedom and had their own synagogue in Jerusalem.
Freedmen@Act.6.9.name: Freedmen

father_of_Barnabas@Col.4.10.description: A reference to the grandfather or other close relative of John Mark.
father_of_Barnabas@Col.4.10.name: father_of_Barnabas

father_of_Conaniah@2Ch.31.12.description: The father of Conaniah, a Levite who supervised the offerings during King Hezekiah's reign.
father_of_Conaniah@2Ch.31.12.name: father_of_Conaniah

father_of_Elizabeth@Luk.1.5.description: Elizabeth was the wife of Zechariah, a priest, and the mother of John the Baptist.
father_of_Elizabeth@Luk.1.5.name: father_of_Elizabeth

father_of_Eunice@2Ti.1.5.description: Eunice's father, unnamed in the Bible, was the maternal grandfather of Timothy.
father_of_Eunice@2Ti.1.5.name: father_of_Eunice

father_of_Hilkiah@Jer.32.7.description: The father of Hilkiah, who was the cousin of the prophet Jeremiah.
father_of_Hilkiah@Jer.32.7.name: father_of_Hilkiah

father_of_Hodiah@1Ch.4.19.description: An unnamed man, the father Naham and his sister Hodiah
father_of_Hodiah@1Ch.4.19.name: father_of_Hodiah

father_of_Lazarus@Luk.10.39.description: The unnamed father of Mary, Martha and Lazarus, who lived in Bethany.
father_of_Lazarus@Luk.10.39.name: father_of_Lazarus

father_of_Mamre@Gen.14.13.description: Mamre's father, an Amorite, was an ally of Abraham during the battle against Chedorlaomer.
father_of_Mamre@Gen.14.13.name: father_of_Mamre

father_of_Nathan@1Ch.11.38.description: The father of Nathan, one of King David's mighty men.
father_of_Nathan@1Ch.11.38.name: father_of_Nathan

father_of_Tahpenes@1Ki.11.19.description: The father of Tahpenes, an Egyptian Pharaoh who gave his daughter in marriage to Hadad the Edomite.
father_of_Tahpenes@1Ki.11.19.name: father_of_Tahpenes

father_of_Timothy@Act.16.1.description: Timothy's father was a Greek man, and his mother was a believing Jewish woman named Eunice.
father_of_Timothy@Act.16.1.name: father_of_Timothy
